notes.title: Clicking rework - Crosshairs & idle improvements!
notes.content:
[h1]Clicking to attack has been reworked!  [/h1]

Spam clicking to fill up the attack bar has been removed and replaced by crosshairs that spawn on the enemy.  Clicking a crosshair will make you attack the enemy instantly!

Critical crosshairs can also spawn which cause you to attack several times in quick succession. The base chance for a crosshair crit is 10%, this can be increased to 40% in the Super Skill Tree.
Critical crosshairs appear golden so you can tell the difference.

Crosshairs can be automatically triggered via Auto-Crosshair upgrades.

[h3]Upgrades relating to clicking and the auto-drone have been reworked:[/h3]

[list]
[*] The auto-tapper drone now increases your Auto-Crosshair chance by 10% per level
[*] The SSP Tree Auto-Drone node now increases your Crosshair Crit Chance from 10% to 40%
[*] The Rusty Woodpecker item now increases your Auto-Crosshair chance by 50% for 10 mins
[/list]

[h3]Other idle improvements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Base attack speed has been buffed for everyone by ~35%
[*] Magnet Mittens (effect: Collect whole scrap piles in one tap) are now given to everyone for free instantly 
[*] Golden Anvil (effect: +3 Max Craft Multiplier) is now given to everyone for free instantly
[*] Comfy Pillow (Increases offline time from 8 to 24 hours) is now given to everyone for free instantly
[*] Two levels of the Auto-Drone upgrade can be purchased for 1 NM each (down from 50/60 - more or less free)
[/list]

Thanks to everyone that has been playing the game so far!

notes.title: More bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] For players that have a corrupted save, if you press 'W' 5 times on the resolution select launcher you will be given an option to wipe your file, allowing you to play again
[*] Fix for an exploit to be in any zone at any wave
[*] Fix for a rare edge case where you could get negative greenprints resulting in you not being able to craft anything
[/list]

notes.title: Lootbug adjustments + save wipe and more
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The 2nd loot button on the lootbug has been adjusted to not look like it costs a steam point
[*] Previously just the 2nd loot button would award a steam point but now both do!
[*] Code 789000000 has been added to wipe your save, this can be used by the few players that have experienced save corruption (There is a series of confirmation steps so you can't do this accidentally)
[*] Stopped the backspace key prompting you to close the game
[*] Fixed the steam point side notification appearing prematurely (You must now wait for the boost to end before you can reactive it - The lootbug steam point change should more than makeup for loss to steam point income this change has made
[*] Misc fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing the Lootbug + fixes
notes.content:
The Lootbug has been introduced!

Spawning approximately every 6 minutes - the Lootbug will appear offering a range of free rewards and boosts along with a steam point!   Can only spawn 15 times a day (resets when dailies reset)

- Fixed an issue where the DLC icon 'pop' was occurring WAY more than intended - whoopsie
- Fix for an exploit to get a lot of a certain currency - thanks to Koalala who reported this to me privately :)
